scope: Navigation semantics only; actual AX identifiers and frames come from the two retained own-case artifacts.

sources.title: Find and use your apps in App Library on iPad
sources.retrieval: Official Apple page text returned by search; direct open returned HTTP 429 and was not retried.
sources.supports: App Library is reached by swiping left beyond the Home pages. Its categories can include apps removed from Home. The candidate does not move apps or change page visibility.

sources.title: Open an app on iPad
sources.supports: Left/right swipes browse actual Home pages.

sources.title: Move apps and widgets on the iPad Home Screen
sources.retrieval: Official Apple page text returned by search.
sources.supports: The page dots represent the available pages and selected page.

limits: No Apple documentation is asserted to specify these private implementation AX identifier strings. They are observed identifiers queried through public XCTest element APIs, not private APIs; fresh native acceptance remains required.
